data.narrative:
Lodge Systems is a pre-seed stage company operating in Defense & Security, a sector containing 26 identifiable peers across public and private markets. The immediate comp universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, with notable private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security sector contains sufficient overall peers, but pre-seed stage companies within the sector lack adequate narrow-stage comparables—only 0 same-stage peers, 1 adjacent-stage peer, and 0 similar-valuation-tier peers were identified. The threshold for reliable peer-median triangulation requires a minimum of 3 datapoints within sufficiently similar filters. Applying sector-wide medians across heterogeneous stages and capital profiles would introduce material distortion.

Without triangulation via peer multiples, this analysis cannot deliver a quantitative valuation range. Proceed with supplementary methods: (1) founder pedigree and market timing assessment, (2) subsequent financing round benchmarks if available, or (3) DCF modeling contingent on revenue projections and capital efficiency metrics not present in current dataset. Key uncertainties center on comparable-stage funding dynamics in frontier defense technology and the applicability of larger, later-stage peers to pre-seed risk and return profiles.
